opportunities_error_title: Give the opportunity a title of 3 to 120 characters.
opportunities_intro: Post what your listing offers or looks for: a partner, a skill, a space, a service or a funding call. Posts are public and stay up for {days} days by default.
opportunities_no_entry: Opportunities are posted by owners of a published listing. You do not have one yet.
opportunities_entry_not_published: Your listing is not published, so you cannot post opportunities right now.
opportunities_review_note: An admin reviews your next opportunity before it goes public.
opportunities_limit_reached: You have reached the limit of {max} open posts. Mark one as filled or wait until one expires.
opportunities_field_deadline_hint: The post closes the day after the deadline. Without one it stays up for {days} days. At most {max} days from today.
opportunities_field_tags_hint: Up to {max} tags, so the right people find the post.
opportunities_reason: Reason: {reason}. We sent you the details by email.
opportunities_fill_body: It stays visible with a Filled label for {days} days, then disappears from the board. You cannot undo this.
opportunities_notice_pending: Thanks. An admin will review your first opportunity before it goes public.
opportunities_refused_limit_active: You already have the maximum number of open posts.
opportunities_refused_limit_daily: You can post {max} new opportunities a day. Try again tomorrow.
opportunities_refused_duplicate: You already have an open post with this title.
opportunities_refused_bad_deadline: The deadline must be between today and {max} days from now, and a renewal needs a later one.
opportunities_refused_invalid_tags: One of the tags is not available. Pick the tags again.
opportunities_refused_not_renewable: This post cannot be renewed right now.
opportunities_refused_not_editable: This post can no longer be edited.

match.countPlural=one: {count} of your opportunities expires soon or has expired.
match.countPlural=other: {count} of your opportunities expire soon or have expired.

opportunities_board_intro: Partners, skills, spaces, services and funding calls that listings offer or look for. To answer a post, open it and contact the listing.
opportunities_board_meta_description: Open calls and offers from creative organizations on {site}: partners, skills, spaces, services and funding calls.
opportunities_detail_banner_expired: This opportunity has expired. It stays here for reference for a while.
opportunities_detail_banner_filled: This opportunity has been filled. It stays here for reference for a while.
opportunities_detail_can_help_hint: Open the listing of {name} and use its contact section to answer this post.
opportunities_detail_gone_title: This opportunity is no longer available
opportunities_detail_gone_body: It was removed or it ended a while ago. You can look for current opportunities on the board.
opportunities_report_body: Tell us what is wrong. An admin reads every report. Nothing is hidden until an admin decides.
opportunities_report_sent: Thank you. We received your report.
opportunities_report_error_wait: Wait a moment for the check to finish, then try again.
opportunities_report_error_limit: Too many reports. Try again later.
opportunities_report_error: The report could not be sent. Try again.
opportunities_review_note_none: Your next opportunity is published at once.
opportunities_board_truncated: Showing the first {shown}. Use the filters to narrow the list.
